# SwayManager

> **File:** `services/compositor/SwayManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

CompositorManager's backend on sway (docs/dev/compositor/contract.md, docs/dev/compositor/sway-backend.md): sway's state as the compositor-neutral shapes (SwayState), and the primitives CompositorManager builds on. Outputs and workspaces come live from Quickshell.I3; the windows from sway's tree (get_tree), read again on its events. The only reader of Quickshell.I3 outside the Sway* services.

### Properties

- `windows` (readonly var): The windows (SwayState.window), most recently used ranked first
- `outputs` (readonly var): The outputs (SwayState.output)
- `workspaces` (readonly var): The numbered workspaces (SwayState.workspace)
- `focusedOutput` (readonly string): The focused output's name, or ""
- `activeWindowId` (readonly string): The focused window's id (its con_id), or "": from focus events as they come, the tree otherwise
- `gapsOut` (readonly var): Sway's gap at the screen edges, after reserved zones: its outer gap plus the inner one every window keeps.
- `fx` (readonly bool): Whether sway is SwayFX (blur, rounded corners, shadows, dimming), once known: its get_version reply adds sway_original_version.
- `ready` (readonly bool): Whether `supports` is final (the variant is known)
- `displayName` (readonly string)
- `surfacesReady` (readonly bool): Sway doesn't stack layers by axiom's order: LayerManager maps them in order itself, from the start
- `travelingTo` (readonly int): Sway has no slides
- `splitWidthMultiplier` (readonly real): Sway doesn't pick a split by the window's shape
- `blur` (readonly var): SwayFX's blur ({ enabled, size, passes }), as the window look set it (setLiveLook), else its config's; plain sway has none
- `supports` (readonly var): What sway does (CompositorManager.supports): SwayFX adds the blur, rounded corners, shadows and dimming.

### Signals

- `layersChanged()`: Never: sway reports no layer surfaces
- `outputsHotplugged()`: An output was connected or disconnected
- `configReloaded()`: Sway reloaded its config (binds and runtime settings reset)
- `keyboardLayoutChanged()`: The keyboard layout switched
- `windowFocused(string appId)`: A window was focused; appId is its app_id (or X11 class)
- `switcherKey(string verb, string argument)`: A window switcher key (a `nop axiom switcher <verb> [argument]` bind): verb `step` (argument the step), `commit` or `cancel`

### Functions

- `refresh()`: Re-reads the outputs, workspaces and windows soon
- `activateWindow(id)`
- `closeWindow(id)`
- `placeWindow(id, workspaceId, targetId, side, restore, reinsert, floatAt)`: The overview's drop (CompositorManager.placeWindow): onto workspace `workspaceId`, next to `targetId` on its `side` ("left" | "right" | "top" | "bottom") when given, or floating at `floatAt` (global).
- `resizeWindow(id, dw, dh, dx, dy)`: Grows a window by (dw, dh) and, when floating, moves it by (dx, dy).
- `warpCursorToLayer(namespace, monitor, width, height, x, y)`: Sway can't move the cursor (supports.cursorWarp is off)
- `toplevelFor(id)`: The Wayland toplevel for a window id, for live previews: none on sway.
- `sendWindowToWorkspace(id)`: Sends the focused window to workspace `id`, staying put
- `scrollStrip(direction)`: Sway has no strips
- `travel(output, legs, mode, focusId)`: A workspace switch (CompositorManager.goToWorkspace).
- `applyRemap(plan, outputs)`: Carries out a remap (WorkspaceGeometry.remapWorkspaces' plan) for `outputs`, the outputs' names in block order.
- `toggleSpecial(name)`: Shows the windows of special group `name` on the focused output, or hides them when any is shown there (SwayState.specialToggle)
- `moveToSpecial(name)`: Puts the focused window in special group `name` (hidden until shown), out of any other: a window is on one special workspace at a time
- `leaveSwitcher()`: Nothing to let go: sway's switcher binds enter no mode (SwitcherKeys reads the keys while it's open), and `mode default` would leave one of the user's own
- `layerApplied()`: axiom's config layer changed sway at runtime (the daemon's compositor.applied): sway sends no event for a gap change, so the windows are read again
- `runCommands(lines, callback)`: Runs sway commands (`lines`), in order, after those sent before
- `setLiveLook(look)`: The window look as set now (CompositorLayer.look; CompositorConfigManager): gapsOut and blur follow its gaps and blur until sway reloads its config, and what sway sets a window at a time (opacity; Sw…
- `withMainBinds(callback)`: Calls back with the binds in effect outside axiom's own modes (the user's, read from their config, and axiom's), or null
- `captureKeys(on)`: While on, every key reaches axiom instead of a bind (the Keybinds page's recorder): an empty mode, left by an unreachable key.
- `withKeyboard(callback)`: Calls back with the main keyboard's layouts ({ layouts, index, keymap }, SwayState.keyboard), or null
- `cycleKeyboardLayout(direction, callback)`: Switches every keyboard to its "next" or "prev" layout, then calls back
- `applyInput(input, inputSchema)`: Sets the input options and cursor now (`input`: CompositorLayer.input's, `inputSchema`: Input's), as their parts say: the greeter's sway, which loads no config of axiom's
- `withCursorPos(callback)`: Sway can't say where the cursor is, nor list layer surfaces
- `withLayerRects(callback)`
- `unsupportedHint(capability)`: What can do what plain sway can't (CompositorManager.unsupportedNote).
- `exitSession()`: Ends the sway session (the power menu's log out)
- `withOutputDetails(callback)`: Calls back with every output in detail, disabled ones too (SwayState.outputDetails), or null
- `applyOutputs(rules, details)`: Sets the outputs as `rules` (MonitorRule) say, now.
